scientific_integrity: The general claim is supported by a complete rational-function proof. Finite symbolic and numerical checks independently corroborate stated identities, not the universal quantifiers. Literature comparison is nonexhaustive.
scientific_limitations: Exact noiseless phase retrieval for polynomials of degree at most d with arbitrary distinct nodes within each of two specified channels. No uniform noise stability, minimal-cardinality claim across all designs, or extension to general differential filters. Relevant 2014 unshifted-derivative theorem is acknowledged as prior work; historical priority is best-knowledge only.
title: Resonance walls and two-point fibers in shifted Euler-derivative phase retrieval
